join hortbot 2 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a test."
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a test?"
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a TeSt."
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "Give 100%"
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "Give _ 110%"
send_any


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote search nothing
send hortbot #foobar [HB] No quote contained that phrase.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote search 100
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Phrase found in quote 4.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote search test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Phrase found in quotes 1, 2, and 3.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote search 0%
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Phrase found in quotes 4 and 5.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote search _ 11
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Phrase found in quote 5.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote search
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !quote search <phrase>


handle hortbot foobar/1 random/3 :!quote search test
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/3 access=subscriber :!quote search test
no_send
